reflection.title: Reflection markers
reflection.description: Inert markers across query, form, JSON, cookie and header delivery.

probes.name: inert_markup_marker
probes.goal: Compare an inert HTML-like marker with the neutral control.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected or logged; no script or callback.

probes.name: template_literal_marker
probes.goal: Observe a template-like marker; expansion is not inferred from HTTP status.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected or interpreted by a template handler in the lab.

probes.name: cookie_marker
probes.goal: Exercise cookie delivery without session impersonation.
probes.side_effects: May replace a lab cookie for this request only.

probes.name: header_marker
probes.goal: Observe a dedicated lab header.
probes.side_effects: May be logged; no forwarding or authentication override.

normalization.title: Encoding & normalization
normalization.description: Compare percent encodings and Unicode forms without external callbacks.

probes.name: literal_percent_quote
probes.goal: Observe one percent-encoded quote as input; transport encodes it again.
probes.side_effects: May be decoded and logged by the application.

probes.name: double_percent_quote
probes.goal: Compare a second encoding layer with a single-layer marker.
probes.side_effects: May be decoded and logged by the application.

probes.name: unicode_composed
probes.goal: Observe the NFC form of an accented marker.
probes.side_effects: May be normalized or logged.

probes.name: unicode_decomposed
probes.goal: Observe the canonically equivalent NFD form; compare manually with NFC.
probes.side_effects: May be normalized or logged.

boundaries.title: Input boundaries
boundaries.description: Small bounded inputs for escaping and JSON scalar/container handling.

probes.name: delimiter_marker
probes.goal: Observe delimiter handling without executing a command or query.
probes.side_effects: May trigger application validation or filtering.

probes.name: json_null_marker
probes.goal: Compare a null value with a neutral object.
probes.side_effects: May trigger lab input validation; no mutation directive.

probes.name: json_array_marker
probes.goal: Observe a small array where a scalar might be expected.
probes.side_effects: May trigger lab input validation; two elements only.

probes.name: bounded_length_marker
probes.goal: Observe a 273-character bounded marker.
probes.side_effects: Slightly larger log entry; no repetition or flood.

demo.title: Fixture response map
demo.description: Eight deterministic response cases, including redirects, server errors and a 429 stop.

probes.name: normal_response
probes.goal: Observe the controlled ok fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: ambiguous_denial
probes.goal: Observe the controlled deny fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: body_denial_signal
probes.goal: Observe the controlled signal fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: custom_status_signal
probes.goal: Observe the controlled custom fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: unfollowed_redirect
probes.goal: Observe the controlled redirect fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: server_error
probes.goal: Observe the controlled error fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: vendor_name_only
probes.goal: Observe the controlled vendor fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

probes.name: rate_limit_stop
probes.goal: Observe the controlled rate fixture response.
probes.side_effects: Canned fixture response; no payload is evaluated.

json_parsing.title: JSON parser discrepancies
json_parsing.description: Duplicate keys, Unicode escapes and two deliberately invalid JSON inputs.

probes.name: json_duplicate_marker_last
probes.goal: Observe conflicting duplicate members with the marker last; parser selection is not inferred from status.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: json_duplicate_marker_first
probes.goal: Reverse duplicate member order to expose first/last/all-member handling in the lab.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: json_escaped_member_name
probes.goal: Observe an escaped member name that decodes to probe.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: json_escaped_marker
probes.goal: Observe an escaped string that decodes to the same literal marker.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: json_nul_before_colon
probes.goal: Observe rejection of a literal NUL between a member name and colon; inspired by the WAFFLED field-wrapper mutation class.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: json_trailing_comma
probes.goal: Observe a deliberately invalid trailing comma; a permissive parser may behave differently.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

xml_parsing.title: XML text representations
xml_parsing.description: CDATA, character references, comments and a namespaced element; no DTD or entities.

probes.name: xml_cdata_marker
probes.goal: Observe text carried inside CDATA without using external entities.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: xml_numeric_marker
probes.goal: Compare numeric character references with literal marker text.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: xml_comment_split_marker
probes.goal: Observe text segments separated by an XML comment.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: xml_namespace_marker
probes.goal: Observe a namespace-qualified element without changing the target URL.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

parameter_pollution.title: Repeated HTTP parameters
parameter_pollution.description: Ordered repeated query/form fields and scalar/array-name ambiguity.

probes.name: hpp_marker_last
probes.goal: Observe two ordered q fields with the marker last.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: hpp_marker_first
probes.goal: Reverse the same q values to expose order-sensitive parsing.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: hpp_scalar_array
probes.goal: Observe scalar and bracketed-array field names without assuming a specific framework.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.

probes.name: hpp_three_values
probes.goal: Observe a bounded three-value parameter list rather than a single embedded query string.
probes.side_effects: May be reflected, logged or rejected by input validation. No callback or executable command is included.
